name: Solyony Medovik
source:
Semyon Kasparyan - 26 years old. A student. A nerd. Everything is as it should be. He is on his way to a reunion, but accidentally takes the wrong route and ends up in the Sovyonok pioneer camp. Backwards. Into the past. He loses his stubble and, on top of that, becomes a decade younger...
But fate doesn't leave him 1-on-1 with the mysterious camp. It gives him an unusual guide to the world of Sovyonok: a counselor's assistant in the form of Leonid.
But this only adds fuel to the fire - the pioneer actually turns out to be just like him, an accidental time-traveler. And now they are together. In the same boat.
What will Semyon choose: searching for answers, or enjoying the unique opportunity to spend a camp shift in the best pioneer camp in the world?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2835221790]Steam[/url]]
translation:
Semyon Kasparyan - 26岁。一名学生。一个书呆子。一切都是它应该的样子。他正在前往重聚的路上，却不小心走错了路，最终进入了索维诺克先锋营。向后。进入过去。他丢掉了胡茬，最重要的是，他年轻了十岁……
但命运并没有让他与神秘阵营一对一。这为他提供了一个进入索维诺克世界的不寻常的向导：列昂尼德形式的顾问助理。
但这只会火上浇油——拓荒者实际上和他一样，是一个偶然的时间旅行者。现在他们在一起了。在同一条船上。
谢苗会选择什么：寻找答案，还是享受在世界上最好的先锋营地度过营地轮班的独特机会？

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2835221790]Steam[/url]]
